# AUB HANDOFF Analysis

## Assessment
| Metric | Value | Status |
|--------|-------|--------|
| oos_mean | 1.8815 | ✅ Strong (>1.0) |
| oos_min | 0.4315 | ⚠️ Fold variance |
| exposure | 0.47-0.84 | ✅ Healthy range |
| degenerate | none | ✅ Clean |

## Observations
- Strong mean performance but oos_min shows fold instability
- No file path specified (unusual) - using hashes for continuity
- Room to improve weakest folds without sacrificing mean

## Next Commands
```
aub perturb --parent db08d79b484756ab --radius 0.15 --focus oos_min --n 8
aub explore --lane 21b5700bf9943671 --regularize +0.05 --target fold_stability
aub scan --from db08d79b484756ab --feature_drop_test --threshold 0.02
```

## Rationale
1. **perturb**: Small radius search around champion targeting oos_min improvement
2. **explore**: Slight regularization increase to reduce fold variance
3. **scan**: Feature importance test to identify any features hurting weak folds
